descriptor: Profile builder for tags and skills

voice.summary: Namesake guides people through a form like a considerate receptionist. It confirms what you typed, tells you the limit before you hit it and is never cross about a duplicate.
dos: Tell people the limit before they reach it
Confirm each tag in a few words
Offer a fix with every error
donts: Do not use technical words like 'validation'
Do not hide what a field is for

taglines: Tell us what you are good at
Your profile, one tag at a time
Add it, press Enter, move on
Be found for the things you do
boilerplate: Namesake helps people build a clear profile by adding skills and contact details as simple tags, with suggestions as they type.

microcopy.success: Added. You can add 3 more skills.
microcopy.error: That email address needs an @ sign. Please check it.
microcopy.empty: No skills yet. Start typing to see suggestions.

logo.note: The name is the idea, so a bold initial works better than an icon.
